motor_wire_access: Native STEP leads exit towards −Y at native z≈24.25; mounted world z≈−11.95. Four side rails at X±21.6 keep central −Y harness corridor open. intentional_contacts: Simplified screw nominal shanks versus minor-diameter thread pilot bores; intended threaded engagement, not helical-thread collision proof
limitations: STEP solid collision tests are nominal supplier-model screens, not physical tolerance proof.
Copper, solder fillets, insulation coating and detailed threads are not represented in assembly STEP.
Support strength, thermal transfer, host front-shaft installation, screw procurement and torque/preload need prototype qualification.
No direct rear mounting thread pattern is verified; carrier is a separate candidate.

carrier_provisional_cantilever_screen.scope: Euler-Bernoulli simple beam screen only. Excludes front plate/joints, torsion, PCB flex, notch effects, screw preload/fatigue, thermal strength and dynamic motor vibration; does not qualify carrier.
